name: sentinelloop-cli
description: Deterministic TDD coding-agent harness for clean TypeScript repositories

scripts.demo: tsc --ignoreConfig --outDir .demo-dist --rootDir . --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2024 --skipLibCheck scripts/mechanism-demo.ts && node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'),fs=require('node:fs');const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,['.demo-dist/scripts/mechanism-demo.js'],{stdio:'inherit'});fs.rmSync('.demo-dist',{recursive:true,force:true});process.exit(r.status??1)"
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
